segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced oiliness, smaller-looking pores, and fewer clogged sebaceous glands, though one with oily skin still saw increased blackheads and acne after two months.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several describe smoother, hydrated, non-tight skin with continued moisturizer use, while others report severe dryness, stiffness, and flaking, especially with daily use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report smoother texture, smaller pores, and no stripping, using the product two to seven times a week.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many describe it as gentle, fragrance-free, and non-irritating even long-term, but others report burning, stinging, cystic breakouts, or a torn/stripped feeling on first use.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports brighter-looking skin after a week with no dryness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report fewer breakouts, better clarity, and help with clogged sebaceous glands and large pores, describing it as a change worth continuing.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers with mature or post-menopausal skin report better overall appearance, fewer breakouts, and improvement with clogged sebaceous glands and large pores.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the product as non-drying even for dry or sensitive skin when paired with moisturizer; several others report significant dryness, tightness, or flaking, particularly with twice-daily use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report no redness or irritation with regular use, including one with rosacea; one reviewer reports her skin became red and puffy after a few weeks.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers citing ceramides and hyaluronic acid describe the product as maintaining or restoring the skin barrier without harshness; one reviewer warns overuse (more than 3x/week) can damage the barrier, and one describes an overstripped feeling.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fewer blackheads, smaller pores, and reduced bumps/sebaceous filaments, particularly around the nose; one reviewer found it did nothing for blackheads or pore filling.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report reduced breakouts, faster-clearing pimples, and improvement in cystic or hormonal acne over weeks to months; several dissent, describing worsened cystic acne, ongoing breakouts, or no improvement at all, sometimes after a purge period.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report a noticeable reduction in oiliness and shine after weeks to years of use.

aspects.libelle: Overstripping with frequent or twice-daily use

extraits.texte: Decided to try it out, but soon realized it wasnt for me. I have dry skin as well as very sensitive skin. Its hard tor me to try new products because my skin sadly doesnt agree with many. This product dried out my face as soon as i rinsed it off and made my face feel stiff. Within a couple of days I started with random cystic acne, but now after a week of having it my bottom half of my face is filled with cystic acne and little bumps.😭 Would not recommend for people witg dry/sensitive skin.

It's odd to see so many telling others NOT to buy this product because of their personal experience. Skincare is subjective and personal and how one's skin reacts to this is highly dependent on skin type and skin care routine. At one time, I used the SA cleanser along with a kitchen sink approach toward getting rid of my acne to include Benzoyl Peroxide cream, retinol etc. So, yeah, I got the expected result: burning, inflamed skin. I got what I deserved because you can't do that and expect a prize. Anyway, I now use this AM & PM, and let me tell you: it's been the missing link to my routine. My skin has never been more vibrant and supple, and my pores are now clear and appear smaller. My skin texture went from orange peel to newborn baby's rear end in two weeks with zero irritation. So, moral of this review is try these products for yourself to see what your skin can tolerate. Do start slowly, perhaps use once per day, and avoid other exfoliating ingredients initially. You can add one back in once your skin acclimates to the SA. I now can use retinol after this at night, vitamin C after this in the morning and I have DRY, SENSITIVE skin. So, success is possible.

extraits.titre: Works so well over time for sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: This cleanser has been lifechanging for me, BUT you have to have patience! It took months and months to fully notice the changes this cleanser has brought in my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin, and when I used to get breakouts, they would be painful and longlasting, taking several weeks to go fully through each pimple's life cycle. Benzoyl peroxide is really drying for me so I hated having to use that constantly. I started using this cleanser (which doesn't dry me out at all), and now when i have breakouts, the pimples last a literal FRACTION of the time they used to! They cycle through in about 3 days now and I rarely have to use spot treatments anymore. I can't say enough about how well this has worked for me. Again, just remember you have to be patient and use this consistently over time! I do occasionally have sensitive skin flareups that this cleanser is too much for, so on those days, I switch to a gentle cleanser, but largely I've had zero issues with this one being too strong.

I have dry, sensitive, menopausal skin with patches of large pores. This cleanser is the first I have found that has addressed all of my skin concerns. Although it is not drying, I occasionally use a more moisturizing cleanser at night during the winter.

I've been using this cleanser about 2 weeks now and it does work for my oily combination skin. I can notice that my pores look a lot smaller and my skin feels smoother. However, this cleanser can dry your face out if you use it everyday so I recommend to use it 2-3 times a week.
I have oily skin and have been using this product for two months in the hopes that it would help with blackheads and acne over 40. I ended up with more blackheads and acne than prior to using it.

I am typically the type of person who thinks that paying more for a product means it is better which I darn well know isn't the case. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin and I honestly feel like absolutely nothing will help. I decided to take it back to the basics and go with simple and gentle. I have used salicylic acid as a chemical exfoliator for years so it is an ingredient my face is use to. I use Paula's Choice liquod exfoliator which exfoliates but does not dry my skin. I knew that this product had salicylic acid in it so I stopped using my other salicylic products so I didn't overdo it. I like the consistently of this cleanser and it suds up very nice. It left me with a clean feel but it left my face very, very dry. I would apply moisturizer right after washing and it was still really dry. I was using it twice a day and now I am only using it at night. I hope to eventually try it again two times a day, maybe when the weather warms up and the air isn't so dry. If you have dry skin or are prone to dry skin, I would not recommend this product.
